summary: Composed the #924 TruthDirected selection policy with the certified exact-data-correction characterization, without identifying a normative demand and an evidence classifier. Constructed two finite controls on the same two-world, two-content semantics. One selects the true empty worldview while identical reports cannot classify the truth of the nonconstant content. The other admits an identity-report classifier while selecting a false worldview. The factorization result forces fiber invariance when a classifier exists. Rejected as invalid: truth-directed selection alone entails a usable evidence criterion, and existence of such a criterion alone entails the truth-directed ought. These are logical non-entailments inside the fixed semantic profile, not refutations of substantive epistemology.
blocker: The model does not exhibit an actual human inquirer or a warranted, computable classifier, and no independent truth-directed duty or psychological no-wishful-thinking obligation is proven. An ontic, deontic or theistic bridge would require a separate argument and rival tests. Root-route open-premise delta: zero.
